note: Le vestiaire d'hiver (s02maison redesign 2026-10-22): first-floor boot room, honey-pine panelling, slate floor, striped rag rug; LANDMARK black cast-iron wood stove (left) with the boot bench, rubber boots and dripping raincoat pegs; rainy window onto the back garden (north wall, plan). Feminine left: Roman lady seated with a harp (tunique), posh lady holding up a sequinned clutch (pochette). Centre: dapper man in a waistcoat on a step stool at the mirror (vestimentaire). Masculine right: man in a yellow raincoat pouring a green watering can over his own head (imperméable), capuchin monkey pulling up the hood of its red raincoat (capuchon), man in a goose costume (déguisement), porter in a red cap pushing a wheeled ready-to-wear rail (prêt-à-porter), cowboy stacking fabric bolts on a crate (textile). Open door on the left wall shows the green-striped accessories room with its vanity mirror (R_wardrobe_03). Zoom on the stove -> the shoe bench by the stove (R_wardrobe_04_z1).
